attributes.description: Date on which the PBM contract ends or was terminated. Null for open-ended contracts. Distinguishes between scheduled expiration and early termination when combined with contract_status. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: vreq_validated
attributes.description: Marker indicating VREQ validation pass

products.name: drug_rebate
products.description: Transactional record capturing drug manufacturer rebate invoices and payments negotiated through the PBM. Captures rebate period, drug NDC, manufacturer name, rebate type (base/performance/market share), contracted rebate rate, utilization units, calculated rebate amount, invoiced amount, received amount, and reconciliation status. Supports MLR (Medical Loss Ratio) reporting and CMS Part D rebate pass-through requirements. [FHIR-aligned]

attributes.name: drug_rebate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each drug manufacturer rebate record in the pharmacy benefit management system. Primary key for the drug_rebate data product.

attributes.name: drug_master_id
attributes.description: FK to pharmacy.drug_master

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulary under which the drug's tier placement drove the rebate calculation.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract under which this rebate was negotiated and invoiced. Links to the governing PBM agreement.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical manufacturer entity responsible for the rebate obligation.

attributes.name: awp_unit_price
attributes.description: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) per unit for the drug as of the rebate period, used as the price benchmark for rebate rate calculations.

attributes.name: calculated_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Rebate amount computed by applying the contracted rebate rate to the utilization units and applicable price benchmark. Represents the expected receivable before invoicing.

attributes.name: contracted_rebate_rate
attributes.description: Negotiated rebate rate expressed as a decimal percentage of Average Wholesale Price (AWP) or Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) per the PBM contract terms. Confidential as it reflects proprietary pricing agreements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this drug rebate record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this rebate record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency reporting for plans operating in US territories.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for a rebate dispute when reconciliation_status is 'disputed'. Captures manufacturer objections, utilization data discrepancies, or contract interpretation differences.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which a disputed rebate was formally resolved. Null if no dispute exists or dispute is still open.

attributes.name: drug_tier
attributes.description: Formulary tier at which the drug was placed during the rebate period, which determines the applicable rebate rate. Tier placement is a key driver of rebate negotiations.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Oracle Financials General Ledger account code to which the rebate receivable or cash receipt is posted. Supports financial close and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate invoice was issued to the manufacturer or PBM. Marks the start of the payment due window per contract terms.

attributes.name: invoiced_amount
attributes.description: Rebate amount formally invoiced to the manufacturer or PBM for the period. May differ from calculated amount due to adjustments, disputes, or rounding.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of business under which the drug utilization generating this rebate was incurred: commercial, medicare_part_d, medicaid, exchange (ACA marketplace), or individual. Drives MLR segmentation and CMS reporting.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the pharmaceutical manufacturer obligated to pay the rebate. Retained on the transaction for reporting and reconciliation without requiring a join.

attributes.name: market_share_pct
attributes.description: Drug's market share within its therapeutic class during the rebate period, expressed as a decimal percentage. Used to determine market share rebate tier attainment per contract.

attributes.name: mlr_rebate_category
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate for ACA Medical Loss Ratio (MLR) reporting purposes: medical_cost_reduction (reduces incurred claims), quality_improvement (allocated to QI activities), or excluded (not counted in MLR numerator).

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: 11-digit National Drug Code identifying the specific drug product (labeler, product, package) subject to the rebate. Formatted as 5-4-2 per FDA NDC Directory standards.

attributes.name: part_d_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rebate is subject to CMS Part D rebate pass-through requirements. True for Medicare Part D covered drugs; False for commercial or Medicaid lines of business.

attributes.name: pass_through_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the received rebate amount that must be passed through to CMS or plan members per Part D or ACA requirements. Critical for MLR and CMS DIR (Direct and Indirect Remuneration) reporting.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual date by which the manufacturer or PBM must remit the rebate payment. Used for aging analysis and dispute escalation.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate payment was actually received and posted. Null if payment has not yet been received.

attributes.name: performance_target_met_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractual performance target (e.g., market share threshold, utilization goal) was met during the rebate period, triggering performance rebate eligibility.

attributes.name: prior_auth_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization was required for the drug during the rebate period. PA requirements can affect utilization volumes and rebate performance thresholds.

attributes.name: rebate_invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-known invoice number assigned by the PBM or manufacturer for this rebate billing cycle. Used for reconciliation with accounts receivable and PBM remittance.

attributes.name: rebate_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the rebate performance or utilization measurement period for which this rebate invoice applies.

attributes.name: rebate_period_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the rebate performance or utilization measurement period (typically a calendar quarter) for which this rebate invoice applies.

attributes.name: rebate_rate_basis
attributes.description: Price benchmark on which the contracted rebate rate is applied: Average Wholesale Price (AWP), Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC), Maximum Allowable Cost (MAC), or net price.

attributes.name: rebate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate by its contractual basis: base (standard formulary placement), performance (quality/utilization targets), market_share (volume threshold), formulary_access (preferred tier), inflation (price increase above CPI), or supplemental (ad hoc negotiated). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base|performance|market_share|formulary_access|inflation|supplemental — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]

attributes.name: received_amount
attributes.description: Actual cash amount received from the manufacturer or PBM for this rebate invoice. Used for cash reconciliation and MLR reporting.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rebate invoice reconciliation process: pending (not yet invoiced), invoiced (invoice sent), partially_received (partial payment), received (fully paid), disputed (discrepancy under review), written_off (uncollectable). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|invoiced|partially_received|received|disputed|written_off — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this rebate record originated: RxClaim, Argus (PBM platforms), or manual (spreadsheet/manual entry). Supports data lineage in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: specialty_drug_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is classified as a specialty drug, which typically carries higher rebate rates and requires prior authorization. Specialty drugs are subject to distinct PBM contract terms.

attributes.name: step_therapy_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy protocols were in effect for this drug during the rebate period. Step therapy requirements influence market share and performance rebate attainment.

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_code
attributes.description: Pharmacological therapeutic class code (e.g., GPI or ATC code) for the drug, used to aggregate rebates by drug category for formulary strategy and analytics.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this drug rebate record was last modified in the data platform. Used to detect changes during incremental Silver layer processing.

attributes.name: utilization_claims_count
attributes.description: Number of pharmacy claims adjudicated for the drug during the rebate period. Used to validate utilization units and support audit of rebate calculations.

attributes.name: utilization_units
attributes.description: Total dispensed units (e.g., tablets, milliliters, grams) of the drug during the rebate period, as reported to the manufacturer for rebate calculation. Sourced from PBM claims data.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between the invoiced amount and the received amount. A non-zero variance triggers reconciliation or dispute resolution workflows.

attributes.name: vreq_validated
attributes.description: Marker indicating VREQ validation pass

attributes.name: wac_unit_price
attributes.description: Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) per unit for the drug as of the rebate period. WAC is the manufacturer's list price and an alternative rebate rate basis to AWP.

products.name: specialty_drug_program
products.description: Master record for specialty pharmacy programs managing high-cost, complex specialty drugs and associated patient affordability programs. Captures program name, specialty drug list (NDCs), specialty pharmacy network, clinical management requirements, REMS flag, cold chain handling, hub services enrollment, and program effective dates. Owns all copay assistance and affordability program tracking: manufacturer copay assistance programs (copay cards), patient assistance programs (PAP), foundation grants, copay accumulator adjustment program (CAAP) interactions, benefit amounts applied, accumulator adjustment flags, and coordination with member out-of-pocket (OOP) accumulators. This is the SSOT for specialty drug management, affordability program administration, accumulator adjustment compliance, and CMS Part D specialty tier reporting. [FHIR-aligned]

attributes.name: specialty_drug_program_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the specialty drug program record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulary under which this specialty drug program operates. Links the program to the applicable drug tier structure and coverage rules managed in the PBM system.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan or benefit plan under which this specialty drug program is offered. Links to the plan and benefit domain for coverage determination and member eligibility.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract governing the administration of this specialty drug program, including pricing terms (MAC, AWP, WAC), dispensing fees, and performance guarantees.

attributes.name: pbm_program_id
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this program as assigned by the PBM system (RxClaim or Argus). Used for reconciliation between the lakehouse and the operational PBM system.

attributes.name: program_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Specialty drug programs are overseen by a program manager employee; required for program governance and reporting.

attributes.name: accumulator_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Copay Accumulator Adjustment Program (CAAP) applies to this specialty drug program. When true, manufacturer copay assistance payments do NOT count toward the member's deductible or Maximum Out-of-Pocket (MOOP). Critical for CMS Part D compliance.

attributes.name: awp_discount_pct
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage applied to the Average Wholesale Price (AWP) for specialty drugs dispensed under this program. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1800 = 18% discount). Governs ingredient cost reimbursement to specialty pharmacies.

attributes.name: clinical_management_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether drugs in this program require active clinical management, including disease management, case management, or care coordination through the Care Management Platform (Casenet TruCare or Altruista).

attributes.name: cms_part_d_specialty_tier_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Part D Specialty Tier Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program is reportable to CMS under the Part D specialty tier requirements. Drives inclusion in CMS Part D formulary submissions and Star Ratings (STAR) calculations.

tag_set.value: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Part D Specialty Tier Flag

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether drugs in this program require temperature-controlled cold chain handling and storage during dispensing and shipping. Drives specialty pharmacy network eligibility and logistics requirements.

attributes.name: copay_assistance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a manufacturer-sponsored copay assistance program (copay card) is available for drugs in this specialty program. Triggers copay accumulator adjustment program (CAAP) evaluation logic.

attributes.name: copay_assistance_max_benefit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount of manufacturer copay assistance benefit available to a member per program year under this specialty drug program. Used in accumulator adjustment calculations and OOP tracking.

attributes.name: copay_assistance_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer-sponsored copay assistance program (e.g., copay card program) associated with this specialty drug program. Used for affordability program tracking and OIG compliance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the specialty drug program record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory compliance requirements under HIPAA and CMS.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Contracted dispensing fee paid to specialty pharmacies per prescription dispensed under this program. Expressed in USD. Component of total pharmacy reimbursement alongside ingredient cost.

attributes.name: drug_utilization_review_type
attributes.description: Type of Drug Utilization Review (DUR) applied to claims under this specialty program. Prospective DUR occurs at point-of-sale; retrospective DUR occurs post-adjudication for quality and safety analysis.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the specialty drug program becomes active and eligible for member enrollment and claim adjudication. Aligns with plan year or contract effective dates.

attributes.name: foundation_grant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether independent charitable foundation grants are available to assist members with cost-sharing obligations for drugs in this specialty program. Foundation grants may or may not count toward OOP accumulators depending on CMS guidance.

attributes.name: hub_services_enrollment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must enroll in a manufacturer-sponsored hub services program to access drugs under this specialty program. Hub services may include patient support, adherence programs, and financial assistance coordination.

attributes.name: icd_condition_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases (ICD) Condition Codes
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes representing the covered clinical conditions for which drugs in this program are indicated. Used for prior authorization (PA) criteria and medical necessity determination.

tag_set.value: International Classification of Diseases (ICD) Condition Codes

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the specialty drug program record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and Silver Layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.

attributes.name: limited_distribution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drugs in this program are classified as Limited Distribution Drugs (LDD), available only through a restricted network of specialty pharmacies designated by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance line of business (LOB) under which this specialty drug program operates. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, formulary rules, and CMS reporting obligations.

attributes.name: mail_order_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether drugs in this program may be dispensed via mail-order pharmacy channels in addition to retail specialty pharmacies.

attributes.name: max_days_supply
attributes.description: Maximum number of days supply permitted per dispensing event for specialty drugs under this program. Typically 30 days for specialty drugs per CMS Part D guidance. Enforced at PBM adjudication.

attributes.name: oop_accumulator_applies_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether third-party assistance payments (copay cards, foundation grants) applied to this program count toward the member's Out-of-Pocket (OOP) and Maximum Out-of-Pocket (MOOP) accumulators. Governs accumulator adjustment compliance.

attributes.name: patient_assistance_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a manufacturer-sponsored Patient Assistance Program (PAP) is available for uninsured or underinsured members enrolled in this specialty drug program.

attributes.name: prior_auth_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Prior Authorization (PA) is required for all drugs covered under this specialty program before dispensing. Drives integration with the Utilization Management (UM) system (InterQual or MCG).

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the specialty drug program within the Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) system (RxClaim or Argus). Used in EDI transactions and CMS Part D reporting.

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specialty drug program, including clinical rationale, covered conditions, and program objectives. Used in plan documents, Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC), and member communications.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the specialty drug program (e.g., 'Oncology Specialty Tier Program', 'Rheumatology Hub Services Program'). Used in member-facing communications and plan documents.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the specialty drug program. Controls whether the program is available for member enrollment and claim adjudication.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specialty drug program by its primary operational function. Drives downstream adjudication logic and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: specialty_tier|hub_services|copay_assistance|patient_assistance|rems|cold_chain|limited_distribution — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quantity_limit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether quantity limit (QL) restrictions apply to drugs dispensed under this specialty program. Quantity limits are enforced at the PBM adjudication level.

attributes.name: rems_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specialty drugs in this program are subject to an FDA-mandated Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS). When true, dispensing requires REMS-certified pharmacy and prescriber enrollment.

tag_set.value: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required Flag

attributes.name: specialty_drug_list_name
attributes.description: Name of the specialty drug list (SDL) associated with this program, identifying the set of National Drug Codes (NDCs) covered under the program. Managed in the PBM formulary system.

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_network_name
attributes.description: Name of the specialty pharmacy network designated to dispense drugs under this program. Defines the restricted network of pharmacies eligible to fill specialty prescriptions.

attributes.name: specialty_tier_designation
attributes.description: Formulary tier designation assigned to specialty drugs in this program. Determines member cost-sharing obligations and CMS Part D specialty tier reporting requirements.

attributes.name: step_therapy_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy protocols are enforced for drugs in this program, requiring members to try and fail on preferred therapies before accessing specialty drugs. Governed by state step therapy laws and CMS guidance.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the specialty drug program is no longer active. Null indicates an open-ended program with no scheduled end. Used for plan year transitions and CMS Part D reporting.

attributes.name: therapeutic_category
attributes.description: Primary therapeutic or disease category associated with the specialty drugs in this program (e.g., Oncology, Rheumatology, Multiple Sclerosis, HIV/AIDS). Used for clinical reporting, HEDIS measures, and population health analytics.

attributes.name: vreq_validated
attributes.description: Marker indicating VREQ validation pass

attributes.name: wac_discount_pct
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage applied to the Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) for specialty drugs in this program. Used as an alternative pricing basis to AWP in PBM contract negotiations.

products.name: mtm_service
products.description: Record for Medication Therapy Management (MTM) services delivered to eligible members, as required under CMS Part D. Captures member eligibility criteria, MTM program enrollment date, comprehensive medication review (CMR) completion date, targeted medication review (TMR) date, pharmacist NPI, interventions recommended, medication action plan (MAP) items, follow-up status, and outcomes. Supports CMS Part D MTM reporting and STAR ratings quality measures. [FHIR-aligned]

attributes.name: mtm_service_id
attributes.description: Primary key for mtm_service

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Part D prescription drug plan (PDP) or Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug (MA-PD) plan under which the member is enrolled and MTM eligibility is determined.

attributes.name: member_subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan member who received the MTM service. Links to the member master record in the core administration platform (Facets/QNXT).

attributes.name: mtm_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific MTM program offering under which this service was delivered. A plan sponsor may operate multiple MTM programs targeting different chronic condition cohorts.

attributes.name: chronic_condition_count
attributes.description: Number of qualifying chronic conditions the member has at the time of MTM eligibility determination. CMS Part D MTM eligibility requires a minimum number of chronic conditions (typically 2-3 depending on plan criteria). Used for eligibility validation and population stratification.

attributes.name: cmr_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the annual Comprehensive Medication Review (CMR) was completed for the member. CMS requires at least one CMR per calendar year for all enrolled MTM beneficiaries. Directly drives the CMS STAR Ratings MTM CMR Completion Rate measure.

attributes.name: cms_reporting_period
attributes.description: CMS Part D reporting period to which this MTM service record is attributed (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-ANNUAL). Used for CMS Part D MTM program reporting submissions and STAR ratings measurement year alignment.

attributes.name: contact_attempt_count
attributes.description: Total number of outreach attempts made to the member to schedule or deliver the MTM service. CMS requires documentation of good-faith efforts to reach enrolled members. Used for compliance audits and outreach effectiveness analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MTM service record was first created in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: disenrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the member was disenrolled or opted out of the MTM program. Null if the member remains enrolled. Used to track program retention and calculate MTM completion rates.

attributes.name: drug_therapy_problem_type
attributes.description: Primary category of drug therapy problem identified during the MTM service. Common types include: unnecessary drug therapy, needs additional drug therapy, ineffective drug, dosage too low, dosage too high, adverse drug reaction, non-adherence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UNNECESSARY_DRUG|NEEDS_ADDITIONAL_DRUG|INEFFECTIVE_DRUG|DOSE_TOO_LOW|DOSE_TOO_HIGH|ADVERSE_REACTION|NON_ADHERENCE|NONE — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dur_outcome_code
attributes.description: NCPDP-standard Drug Utilization Review (DUR) outcome code documenting the result of the pharmacist's clinical intervention during the MTM service (e.g., 1A = filled as is, 1B = filled with prescriber approval, 1C = not filled). Sourced from RxClaim or Argus PBM system DUR transaction records.

attributes.name: eligibility_determination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the member was determined to be eligible for the MTM program based on CMS Part D criteria (multiple chronic conditions, multiple Part D drugs, likely to incur annual costs above the CMS threshold).

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the eligible member was enrolled into the MTM program. CMS requires auto-enrollment of all eligible beneficiaries with opt-out capability.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_drug_cost
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Annual Part D Drug Cost
attributes.description: Estimated annual cost of Part D covered drugs for the member at the time of MTM eligibility determination. CMS requires members likely to incur annual drug costs above the established threshold to be enrolled. Expressed in USD.

tag_set.value: Estimated Annual Part D Drug Cost

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date of the follow-up contact or service following the MTM encounter. Null if no follow-up is required or scheduled. Used to track closure of open MAP items and clinical recommendations.

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up contact or service is required after the current MTM encounter based on clinical findings or unresolved MAP items. True = follow-up required; False = no follow-up needed.

attributes.name: follow_up_status
attributes.description: Current status of the follow-up action required after the MTM service. PENDING = follow-up scheduled but not yet completed; COMPLETED = follow-up successfully conducted; DECLINED = member declined follow-up; UNREACHABLE = member could not be contacted for follow-up; NOT_REQUIRED = no follow-up needed.

attributes.name: intervention_count
attributes.description: Total number of clinical interventions or recommendations made during the MTM service encounter (e.g., drug therapy problem resolutions, adherence recommendations, prescriber referrals). Used for quality reporting and pharmacist productivity analytics.

attributes.name: last_contact_attempt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent outreach attempt made to the member for MTM scheduling or delivery. Used alongside contact_attempt_count to document good-faith outreach efforts for CMS compliance.

attributes.name: map_item_count
attributes.description: Number of action items documented in the Medication Action Plan (MAP) provided to the member. Each MAP item represents a specific recommendation or goal agreed upon between the pharmacist and the member.

attributes.name: map_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a written Medication Action Plan (MAP) was provided to the member following the CMR. CMS requires a standardized MAP to be delivered to the member and their prescriber(s) after each CMR. True = MAP provided; False = MAP not yet provided.

attributes.name: member_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member provided consent to participate in the MTM service and for sharing of clinical findings with their prescriber(s). True = consent obtained; False = consent not obtained or pending. Required for HIPAA compliance when sharing PHI with prescribers.

attributes.name: opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted out of the MTM program. CMS requires auto-enrollment with opt-out capability. True = member has opted out; False = member remains enrolled. When True, disenrollment_date should be populated.

attributes.name: opt_out_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the member's opt-out or disenrollment from the MTM program. Null if the member has not opted out. Used for program retention analysis and CMS reporting.

attributes.name: part_d_drug_count
attributes.description: Number of Part D covered drugs the member is taking at the time of MTM eligibility determination. CMS Part D MTM eligibility requires a minimum number of Part D drugs (typically 8 or more). Used for eligibility validation.

attributes.name: pbm_member_code
attributes.description: Member identifier assigned by the Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) system (RxClaim or Argus) used to cross-reference the MTM record with pharmacy claims and formulary data.

attributes.name: personal_medication_list_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Personal Medication List (PML) was provided to the member as part of the CMR standardized format. CMS requires both a MAP and a PML to be delivered following each CMR. True = PML provided; False = PML not provided.

attributes.name: pharmacist_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the pharmacist or clinical pharmacist who delivered the MTM service, including Comprehensive Medication Review (CMR) or Targeted Medication Review (TMR). Required for CMS Part D MTM reporting.

attributes.name: pharmacist_recommendation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text clinical notes documenting the pharmacist's recommendations, findings, and interventions during the MTM service encounter. Contains Protected Health Information (PHI) and must be handled in accordance with HIPAA Privacy Rule requirements.

attributes.name: prescriber_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the prescriber(s) were notified of the MTM service findings and MAP items. Null if notification has not yet been sent. Used for compliance tracking against CMS timelines.

attributes.name: prescriber_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member's prescriber(s) were notified of the MTM service findings, recommendations, or MAP items. CMS requires that the MAP and relevant clinical findings be shared with the prescriber. True = prescriber notified; False = notification pending or not completed.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the MTM service (CMR, TMR, or follow-up) was delivered to the member. This is the principal real-world event date used for CMS Part D MTM reporting and STAR ratings quality measure calculations.

attributes.name: service_delivery_channel
attributes.description: Mode through which the MTM service was delivered to the member. CMS requires CMRs to be offered as interactive, person-to-person consultations (in-person or telehealth). Supports channel-level analytics and compliance verification.

attributes.name: service_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the MTM service encounter in minutes. Used for pharmacist productivity reporting, billing reconciliation with PBM, and quality analytics. CMR encounters typically range from 30 to 60 minutes.

attributes.name: service_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MTM service record. SCHEDULED = appointment set; IN_PROGRESS = service initiated; COMPLETED = service fully delivered and documented; DECLINED = member declined participation; UNREACHABLE = member could not be contacted; CANCELLED = service cancelled prior to delivery.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MTM service delivered. CMR = Comprehensive Medication Review (annual face-to-face or telehealth); TMR = Targeted Medication Review (quarterly or as needed); FOLLOW_UP = follow-up contact on prior CMR/TMR; REFERRAL = referral to prescriber or specialist; OTHER = other MTM-related service.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this MTM service record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across PBM (RxClaim/Argus) and Care Management (Casenet TruCare/Altruista) platforms.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating source system (RxClaim, Argus, Casenet TruCare, or Altruista) for this MTM service record. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system traceability in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: star_measure_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MTM service record is eligible to be counted toward the CMS STAR Ratings MTM Completion Rate for Comprehensive Medication Reviews (CMR) quality measure. True = eligible for STAR measure numerator/denominator; False = excluded from STAR measure calculation.

attributes.name: tmr_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent Targeted Medication Review (TMR) was conducted. TMRs are performed at least quarterly for enrolled members who have not yet received a CMR or as clinically indicated. Null if no TMR has been performed.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MTM service record was last modified in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, incremental processing, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: vreq_validated
attributes.description: Marker indicating VREQ validation pass

products.name: formulary_exception
products.description: Transactional record for member or prescriber requests to cover a non-formulary drug or override a formulary restriction (tier exception, PA exception, step therapy exception). Captures request date, member ID, prescriber NPI, requested drug NDC, exception type, clinical justification, decision status (approved/denied), effective date range, and appeal rights notification. Supports CMS Part D coverage determination and exception request requirements. [FHIR-aligned]

attributes.name: formulary_exception_id
attributes.description: Primary key for formulary_exception

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associated appeal record if the member or prescriber has filed an appeal against a denied formulary exception. Links to the appeals management entity. Null if no appeal has been filed.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical pharmacist, pharmacy technician, or medical director who reviewed and rendered the decision on the formulary exception request. Links to the workforce/staff entity.

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific formulary against which the exception is being evaluated. A plan may maintain multiple formularies (e.g., commercial, Medicare Part D, Medicaid). Links to the formulary master in the PBM system (RxClaim/Argus).

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the health benefit plan under which the formulary exception is being requested. Determines the applicable formulary, tier structure, and exception adjudication rules.

attributes.name: member_identity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the health plan member on whose behalf the formulary exception request is submitted. Links to the member master record in the core administration platform (Facets/QNXT).

attributes.name: prior_authorization_id
attributes.description: Identifier of an associated Prior Authorization (PA) request in the UM system (InterQual/MCG) when the formulary exception is linked to or triggered by a PA requirement. Null if no PA is associated.

attributes.name: appeal_rights_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the appeal rights notification was sent to the member and prescriber following a denial. Required for CMS Part D compliance tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: appeal_rights_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required appeal rights notification was sent to the member and prescriber following a denial decision, as mandated by CMS Part D regulations. True = notification sent; False = notification not yet sent.

attributes.name: clinical_justification
attributes.description: Free-text clinical rationale provided by the prescriber or member supporting the formulary exception request. May include diagnosis, treatment history, contraindications to formulary alternatives, or medical necessity documentation. Treated as confidential clinical information.

attributes.name: cms_coverage_determination_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Coverage Determination Type
attributes.description: CMS-defined classification of the coverage determination process type for Part D reporting. Standard: routine 72-hour review; Expedited: 24-hour urgent review; Reopen: plan-initiated reconsideration; Revised: updated determination on a prior decision.

tag_set.value: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Coverage Determination Type

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the formulary exception record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: current_drug_tier
attributes.description: The formulary tier at which the requested drug is currently placed (or non_formulary if not on the formulary) at the time the exception request is submitted. Used to assess the tier differential and cost-sharing impact of the exception. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tier_1|tier_2|tier_3|tier_4|tier_5|specialty|non_formulary — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: days_supply_requested
attributes.description: Number of days of drug supply requested in the formulary exception, applicable for quantity limit or day supply override exceptions. Standard values are 30, 60, or 90 days.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the final determination (approval or denial) was made on the formulary exception request. Used to calculate turnaround time and assess CMS timeliness compliance.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the exception determination was rendered. Enables exact measurement of response time against CMS 72-hour standard and 24-hour expedited decision deadlines.

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for denial of the formulary exception request (e.g., formulary alternative available, insufficient clinical documentation, drug not medically necessary). Null for approved or pending requests. Used in EOB and appeal rights notifications.

attributes.name: denial_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable explanation of the reason for denial of the formulary exception request. Included in the written notice of denial sent to the member and prescriber as required by CMS Part D regulations.

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.description: International Classification of Diseases (ICD-10-CM) diagnosis code supporting the medical necessity of the requested drug. Provided by the prescriber as part of the clinical justification for the exception. Treated as confidential health information.

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic name of the drug for which the formulary exception is requested, as submitted by the requestor. Stored for human-readable reference alongside the NDC code.

attributes.name: drug_ndc
attributes.description: 11-digit National Drug Code (NDC) of the specific drug product for which the formulary exception is requested. Identifies the labeler, product, and package configuration at the NDC level.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date through which an approved formulary exception remains valid. After this date, the member must reapply or the standard formulary restriction resumes. Null for open-ended approvals or non-approved requests.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which an approved formulary exception is valid and the member may obtain the drug at the excepted tier or without the formulary restriction. Null for denied or pending requests.

attributes.name: exception_request_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable unique reference number assigned to the formulary exception request at intake. Used by members, prescribers, and pharmacies to track the status of the request. Generated by the PBM system (RxClaim/Argus) or UM system.

attributes.name: exception_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the formulary exception request. Pending: under review; Approved: exception granted; Denied: exception not granted; Withdrawn: requestor cancelled; Expired: approved exception past effective period; Appealed: denial under appeal review.

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Classification of the formulary exception request indicating the specific restriction being challenged. Values: non_formulary (drug not on formulary), tier_exception (request lower cost-sharing tier), pa_exception (override Prior Authorization requirement), step_therapy_exception (bypass step therapy protocol), quantity_limit_exception (override quantity/day supply limit), coverage_determination (standard CMS Part D coverage determination). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_formulary|tier_exception|pa_exception|step_therapy_exception|quantity_limit_exception|coverage_determination — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: formulary_alternative_ndc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Formulary Alternative Drug National Drug Code (NDC)
attributes.description: 11-digit NDC of the formulary-covered alternative drug suggested by the plan when denying a non-formulary or tier exception request. Required by CMS to be communicated to the member and prescriber in the denial notice.

tag_set.value: Formulary Alternative Drug National Drug Code (NDC)

attributes.name: is_expedited
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulary exception request was submitted and processed under the expedited (24-hour) review pathway, as opposed to the standard (72-hour) pathway. Expedited requests require prescriber attestation that the standard timeframe would seriously jeopardize the member's life, health, or ability to regain maximum function.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of Business (LOB) under which the formulary exception is processed. Determines applicable regulatory framework, formulary rules, and exception adjudication standards (e.g., CMS Part D rules apply only to Medicare Part D LOB).

attributes.name: prescriber_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the prescribing physician or authorized prescriber who submitted or supports the formulary exception request. Required for CMS Part D coverage determination documentation.

attributes.name: quantity_requested
attributes.description: The quantity of the drug (in dispensing units) for which the exception is requested, applicable for quantity limit exception requests. Expressed in the drug's standard dispensing unit (e.g., tablets, milliliters).

attributes.name: request_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the formulary exception request was submitted. Values: phone (member/prescriber call), fax (fax submission), portal (member or prescriber web portal), edi (electronic data interchange transaction), mail (paper/postal), prescriber_portal (dedicated prescriber e-prescribing or PBM portal).

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the formulary exception request was formally submitted by the member, prescriber, or authorized representative. This is the principal business event date used for CMS timeliness compliance tracking (72-hour standard, 24-hour expedited).

attributes.name: request_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the formulary exception request was received and logged in the PBM or UM system. Used for exact timeliness measurement against CMS regulatory response deadlines.

attributes.name: requested_drug_tier
attributes.description: The formulary cost-sharing tier to which the requestor is asking the drug to be assigned for this member (e.g., requesting Tier 2 generic pricing for a Tier 3 preferred brand). Applicable for tier exception requests.

attributes.name: requestor_type
attributes.description: Identifies who initiated the formulary exception request. Member: the enrollee themselves; Prescriber: the treating physician or authorized prescriber; Authorized Representative: a legally designated representative acting on behalf of the member; Pharmacy: the dispensing pharmacy acting on behalf of the member.

attributes.name: review_level
attributes.description: Level of clinical review applied to the formulary exception request. Pharmacist: initial review by clinical pharmacist; Medical Director: escalated review by physician medical director; Peer to Peer: prescriber-to-medical-director discussion; Committee: pharmacy and therapeutics committee review.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this formulary exception record originated. Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer. Values: rxclaim, argus (PBM systems), interqual, mcg (UM systems), facets, qnxt (core admin), manual (manually entered). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rxclaim|argus|interqual|mcg|facets|qnxt|manual — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: step_therapy_drugs_tried
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of NDCs or drug names of step therapy prerequisite drugs that the member has already tried and failed, as documented in the step therapy exception request. Supports clinical review and CMS step therapy override requirements.

attributes.name: supporting_doc_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required clinical supporting documentation (e.g., prescriber letter of medical necessity, lab results, treatment history) has been received from the prescriber or member. True = documentation received; False = documentation pending or not received.

attributes.name: supporting_doc_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the required clinical supporting documentation was received from the prescriber or member. Used to calculate the effective review start date and CMS timeliness compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the formulary exception record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks status changes, decision updates, and documentation additions throughout the exception lifecycle.

attributes.name: vreq_validated
attributes.description: Marker indicating VREQ validation pass

products.name: part_d_submission
products.description: Transactional record tracking CMS Part D regulatory data submissions including RAPS (Risk Adjustment Processing System) pharmacy encounter submissions, EDPS (Encounter Data Processing System) submissions, Direct and Indirect Remuneration (DIR) reporting, and Coverage Gap Discount Program (CGDP) invoicing. Captures submission batch ID, submission type, submission date, reporting period, record count, accepted count, rejected count, CMS response code, error detail, reconciliation status, and resubmission flag. Supports CMS Part D compliance, risk adjustment revenue integrity, and regulatory filing audit trail. [FHIR-aligned]

attributes.name: part_d_submission_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each CMS Part D regulatory data submission record in the lakehouse silver layer. Serves as the primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: The CMS-assigned Plan Benefit Package identifier associated with this submission. Distinguishes specific benefit packages within a Part D contract for formulary, cost-sharing, and coverage gap reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_submission. Business justification: Part D submissions are a type of regulatory filing; linking to regulatory_submission records submission details and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: accepted_record_count
attributes.description: The number of records within the submission batch that CMS accepted and processed successfully. Derived from the CMS acknowledgment response file. Used to calculate acceptance rate and identify partial rejections.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned batch identifier assigned by the CMS submission system (RAPS, EDPS, or CGDP portal) for the submission file. Used to correlate records across the submission lifecycle and match CMS acknowledgment responses.

attributes.name: benefit_year
attributes.description: The four-digit calendar year of the Medicare Part D benefit period to which this submission applies. Drives payment year reconciliation, risk adjustment settlement, and DIR reporting cycles with CMS.

attributes.name: cgdp_invoice_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Coverage Gap Discount Program (CGDP) Invoice Amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount invoiced under the Coverage Gap Discount Program for this submission, applicable to CGDP submission types. Represents manufacturer discount obligations for brand-name drugs dispensed to Part D beneficiaries in the coverage gap.

tag_set.value: Coverage Gap Discount Program (CGDP) Invoice Amount

attributes.name: clearinghouse_tracking_number
attributes.description: The tracking or reference identifier assigned by the EDI clearinghouse (Availity or Change Healthcare) upon receipt of the submission file. Used to trace submission status through the clearinghouse to CMS.

attributes.name: cms_contract_number
attributes.description: The CMS-assigned Part D plan contract identifier (e.g., H1234 or S5678) under which this submission is filed. Identifies the health plan's Medicare Part D contract for regulatory reporting and payment purposes.

attributes.name: cms_region_code
attributes.description: The CMS regional office code associated with the Part D contract under which this submission is filed. Used for regulatory routing and regional compliance reporting.

attributes.name: cms_response_code
attributes.description: The acknowledgment or disposition code returned by CMS upon processing the submission batch. Maps to CMS-defined response code sets (e.g., RAPS response codes, EDPS acknowledgment codes). Used for automated error triage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: cms_response_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: CMS Response Receipt Date and Time
attributes.description: The timestamp when the CMS acknowledgment or response file was received by the health plan. Used to calculate CMS processing turnaround time and to trigger downstream reconciliation workflows.

tag_set.value: CMS Response Receipt Date and Time

attributes.name: cms_response_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the CMS response code returned for this submission. Provides context for the acceptance, rejection, or error condition reported by CMS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this Part D submission record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Serves as the record audit created timestamp for data lineage and ETL traceability.

attributes.name: dir_amount
attributes.description: The total Direct and Indirect Remuneration dollar amount reported in this submission, applicable to DIR submission types. Represents post-point-of-sale price concessions, rebates, and other remuneration from manufacturers and pharmacies that reduce net drug costs. Required for CMS Part D DIR reconciliation.

attributes.name: edi_interchange_control_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Interchange Control Number
attributes.description: The ISA13 interchange control number from the EDI transmission envelope, applicable to EDI-formatted submissions. Used to correlate submission files with EDI gateway acknowledgments (997/999) from the clearinghouse or CMS.

tag_set.value: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Interchange Control Number

attributes.name: error_detail
attributes.description: Structured or free-text description of errors returned by CMS for rejected or partially accepted records. May include CMS error codes, field-level rejection reasons, and record-level identifiers. Supports error remediation and resubmission workflows.

attributes.name: hcc_record_count
attributes.description: The number of Hierarchical Condition Category diagnosis records included in this submission batch, applicable to RAPS and EDPS submission types. Used to monitor HCC capture completeness and risk score optimization.

attributes.name: is_resubmission
attributes.description: Indicates whether this submission is a resubmission of a previously rejected or corrected batch (True) or an original submission (False). Used to track correction cycles and measure first-pass acceptance rates.

attributes.name: is_timely_submission
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submission was transmitted to CMS on or before the regulatory deadline date (True) or after the deadline (False). Supports CMS compliance reporting and internal SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The Medicare Part D line of business associated with this submission. MAPD = Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug plan; PDP = standalone Prescription Drug Plan; EGWP = Employer Group Waiver Plan; LIS = Low Income Subsidy. Drives regulatory reporting segmentation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, manual override justifications, or compliance annotations associated with this submission record. Used by compliance and operations teams to document exception handling, CMS communications, or remediation actions.

attributes.name: original_batch_number
attributes.description: For resubmissions, the batch_id of the original submission that this record corrects or replaces. Null for original submissions. Enables lineage tracing across submission correction cycles.

attributes.name: pbm_system_source
attributes.description: Identifies the source PBM system from which the submission data was extracted. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements. Values align to operational PBM platforms (RxClaim, Argus).

attributes.name: pde_record_count
attributes.description: The number of Prescription Drug Event records included in this submission batch, applicable to PDE and EDPS submission types. PDE records are the foundational data element for CMS Part D payment and reconciliation.

attributes.name: pending_record_count
attributes.description: The number of records within the submission batch that CMS has received but not yet finalized (e.g., held for additional review or in a processing queue). Supports real-time submission status monitoring.

attributes.name: raf_impact_amount
attributes.description: The estimated revenue impact in dollars attributable to the risk adjustment data submitted in this batch, applicable to RAPS and EDPS submission types. Supports risk adjustment revenue integrity analysis and HCC-based payment reconciliation.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the submission was fully reconciled against the CMS response. Null if reconciliation is not yet complete. Used for SLA tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Indicates the reconciliation state of the submission against CMS response data. UNRECONCILED = CMS response not yet matched; IN_PROGRESS = reconciliation underway; RECONCILED = fully matched and closed; EXCEPTION = discrepancy identified requiring manual review.

attributes.name: rejected_record_count
attributes.description: The number of records within the submission batch that CMS rejected. Derived from the CMS acknowledgment response file. Drives error remediation workflows and resubmission prioritization.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the reporting period covered by this Part D submission. Together with reporting_period_start_date, defines the data window for the submission batch.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the reporting period covered by this Part D submission. Used to align submission data with the applicable benefit year, payment year, or reconciliation cycle as defined by CMS.

attributes.name: resubmission_attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of resubmission attempts for a given original batch. Value is 0 for original submissions, 1 for first resubmission, 2 for second, etc. Supports escalation workflows and CMS deadline compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world event timestamp recording when the submission batch was transmitted to CMS. Distinct from the record audit created timestamp. Used for timeliness compliance tracking against CMS filing deadlines.

attributes.name: submission_deadline_date
attributes.description: The regulatory deadline date by which this submission must be received by CMS. Used to assess timeliness compliance and trigger escalation alerts for at-risk submissions.

attributes.name: submission_file_name
attributes.description: The name of the file transmitted to CMS for this submission batch. Used for audit trail, resubmission tracking, and reconciliation against CMS acknowledgment files.

attributes.name: submission_format
attributes.description: The electronic data interchange or file format used for the CMS submission. EDI_837 = ANSI X12 837 pharmacy claim transaction; FLAT_FILE = CMS-specified fixed-width flat file; XML = extensible markup language; CSV = comma-separated values.

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the Part D submission. PENDING = prepared but not yet transmitted; SUBMITTED = transmitted to CMS; ACCEPTED = CMS confirmed full acceptance; REJECTED = CMS rejected the batch; PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED = CMS accepted a subset of records; RECONCILED = submission reconciled against CMS response and closed.

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of CMS Part D regulatory submission. RAPS = Risk Adjustment Processing System pharmacy encounter; EDPS = Encounter Data Processing System; DIR = Direct and Indirect Remuneration report; CGDP = Coverage Gap Discount Program invoice; PDE = Prescription Drug Event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RAPS|EDPS|DIR|CGDP|PDE — promote to reference product if additional types are added]

attributes.name: submitter_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization or entity submitting the Part D data to CMS. May be the health plan, TPA, or PBM acting on behalf of the plan. Supports audit trail and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: total_record_count
attributes.description: The total number of records (encounters, claims, or line items) included in the submission batch as transmitted to CMS. Used as the control total for reconciliation against CMS acknowledgment.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this Part D submission record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Used to detect record changes, support incremental processing, and maintain audit trail integrity.

attributes.name: vreq_validated
attributes.description: Marker indicating VREQ validation pass

products.name: benefit_accumulator
products.description: Tracks member-level pharmacy benefit accumulator balances including deductible applied, out-of-pocket (OOP) spend, maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP) progress, true out-of-pocket (TrOOP) for Medicare Part D, initial coverage limit (ICL) progress, and catastrophic coverage threshold. Updated in real-time with each pharmacy claim adjudication event. Supports real-time cost-sharing calculation at point of sale, coverage gap (donut hole) determination for Part D members, low-income subsidy (LIS) cost-sharing adjustments, and member Explanation of Benefits (EOB) generation. Critical for CMS Part D benefit phase tracking and annual reconciliation. [FHIR-aligned]

attributes.name: benefit_accumulator_id
attributes.description: Primary key for benefit_accumulator

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the employer group or sponsor associated with the member's pharmacy benefit. Relevant for group-level accumulator reporting and ASO/TPA arrangements.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the health benefit plan under which the member is enrolled, determining the applicable deductible, OOP maximum, and Part D benefit phase thresholds.

attributes.name: member_subscriber_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member whose pharmacy benefit accumulators are being tracked. Links to the member master record in the enrollment system (Facets/QNXT).

attributes.name: pharmacy_claim_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the most recent pharmacy claim that triggered an update to this accumulator record. Supports audit trail and real-time adjudication reconciliation.

attributes.name: accumulator_reset_date
attributes.description: Date on which the accumulator balances were last reset to zero, typically at the start of a new benefit year. Supports annual reconciliation and audit of accumulator lifecycle.

attributes.name: accumulator_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated or last updated this accumulator record (e.g., RxClaim, Argus PBM, Facets, QNXT). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: accumulator_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the accumulator record. 'active' indicates in-use for real-time adjudication; 'suspended' indicates member eligibility gap; 'closed' indicates benefit period ended; 'pending_reset' indicates awaiting annual reset; 'reconciled' indicates CMS or plan reconciliation completed.

attributes.name: accumulator_version
attributes.description: Optimistic locking version counter incremented with each update to the accumulator record. Supports concurrent adjudication event handling and prevents race conditions in real-time point-of-sale updates.

attributes.name: benefit_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the benefit year or coverage period to which this accumulator record applies. Defines the boundary for annual accumulator reset.

attributes.name: benefit_period_start_date
attributes.description: First date of the benefit year or coverage period to which this accumulator record applies. Accumulators reset at the start of each new benefit period.

attributes.name: catastrophic_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative drug cost amounts applied toward the Medicare Part D catastrophic coverage threshold. Tracks member spend after exiting the coverage gap and entering catastrophic coverage.

attributes.name: catastrophic_limit_amt
attributes.description: The Medicare Part D catastrophic coverage threshold amount for the current benefit year. Once TrOOP reaches this level, the member qualifies for catastrophic cost-sharing rates. Published annually by CMS.

attributes.name: cms_reconciliation_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Reconciliation Status
attributes.description: Status of the CMS annual Part D reconciliation process for this accumulator record. Tracks whether the accumulator data has been submitted to and accepted by CMS via RAPS/EDPS for risk adjustment and subsidy reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Reconciliation Status

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_type
attributes.description: Indicates the coordination of benefits (COB) role of this plan for the member's pharmacy benefit. Determines how accumulator amounts are applied when multiple payers are involved.

attributes.name: coverage_gap_discount_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative manufacturer discount amounts applied to brand-name drugs while the member is in the Medicare Part D coverage gap (donut hole). These discounts count toward TrOOP under the ACA Coverage Gap Discount Program.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this accumulator record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: deductible_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar amount the member has applied toward their pharmacy deductible in the current benefit period. Updated with each pharmacy claim adjudication event. Used at point of sale to determine member cost-sharing responsibility.

attributes.name: deductible_limit_amt
attributes.description: Total pharmacy deductible amount the member must satisfy before plan cost-sharing begins, as defined in the benefit plan design for the current benefit period.

attributes.name: eob_generated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Explanation of Benefits (EOB) has been generated for the member reflecting the current accumulator balances. Supports member communication and regulatory EOB delivery requirements.

attributes.name: family_deductible_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar amount applied toward the family-level pharmacy deductible for plans with embedded or aggregate family deductible structures. Applicable for commercial group plans with family coverage tiers.

attributes.name: family_oop_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative out-of-pocket spend applied toward the family-level MOOP for plans with family OOP limits. Tracks combined member cost-sharing across all family members enrolled under the same plan.

attributes.name: formulary_tier_applied
attributes.description: The formulary drug tier level most recently applied during adjudication for this member's accumulator. Indicates the cost-sharing tier structure in effect, which affects deductible and OOP accumulation rates.

attributes.name: hsa_eligible_applied_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Savings Account (HSA) Eligible Applied Amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of pharmacy cost-sharing that qualifies as HSA-eligible expenses under IRS rules for members enrolled in a High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP). Supports member HSA contribution and tax reporting.

tag_set.value: Health Savings Account (HSA) Eligible Applied Amount

attributes.name: icl_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative total drug costs (plan paid plus member cost-sharing) applied toward the Medicare Part D Initial Coverage Limit (ICL). When this amount reaches the ICL threshold, the member enters the coverage gap (donut hole).

attributes.name: icl_limit_amt
attributes.description: The Medicare Part D Initial Coverage Limit (ICL) threshold amount for the current benefit year, as published annually by CMS. Defines the boundary between the initial coverage phase and the coverage gap (donut hole).

attributes.name: is_deductible_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has fully satisfied their pharmacy deductible for the current benefit period. When true, plan cost-sharing (copay/coinsurance) applies rather than full deductible responsibility.

attributes.name: is_moop_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has reached their maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP) limit for the current benefit period. When true, the plan covers 100% of covered pharmacy costs for the remainder of the benefit period.

attributes.name: last_adjudication_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent pharmacy claim adjudication event that updated this accumulator record. Critical for real-time point-of-sale cost-sharing calculation and concurrency control.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The line of business (LOB) under which the member's pharmacy benefit is administered. Determines applicable regulatory framework, benefit phase rules, and accumulator logic (e.g., Part D coverage gap applies only to Medicare Part D).

attributes.name: lis_copay_tier
attributes.description: The applicable LIS copay tier for the member, determining the fixed copay amounts for generic, preferred brand, non-preferred, and specialty drugs under the Low-Income Subsidy (LIS) program.

attributes.name: lis_level
attributes.description: Low-Income Subsidy (LIS) eligibility level for Medicare Part D members, determining reduced cost-sharing amounts. 'full' indicates 100% subsidy; 'partial_1/2/3' indicate graduated subsidy tiers; 'none' indicates no LIS. Affects TrOOP accumulation rules.

attributes.name: mail_order_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative cost-sharing amount applied for drugs dispensed through mail-order pharmacy channels in the current benefit period. Supports mail-order utilization reporting and member EOB generation.

attributes.name: moop_limit_amt
attributes.description: The maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP) dollar threshold the member must reach before the plan covers 100% of covered pharmacy costs for the remainder of the benefit period. Set per plan design and ACA/CMS requirements.

attributes.name: oop_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative out-of-pocket (OOP) spend by the member for pharmacy benefits in the current benefit period, including deductible, copays, and coinsurance. Used to track progress toward the maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP) limit.

attributes.name: part_d_benefit_phase
attributes.description: Current Medicare Part D benefit phase for the member based on accumulated TrOOP and ICL amounts. Drives cost-sharing calculation at point of sale. 'not_applicable' for non-Part D lines of business.

attributes.name: pbm_member_code
attributes.description: Member identifier assigned by the Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) system (RxClaim or Argus). Used to cross-reference accumulator balances between the health plan and PBM for reconciliation.

attributes.name: rx_claim_count
attributes.description: Total number of pharmacy claims adjudicated and applied to this accumulator record in the current benefit period. Used for utilization reporting and EOB generation.

attributes.name: specialty_drug_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative cost-sharing amount applied specifically for specialty tier drugs in the current benefit period. Tracked separately to support specialty pharmacy reporting, prior authorization analytics, and plan design evaluation.

attributes.name: third_party_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar amount paid by third parties (e.g., manufacturer copay assistance programs, other insurance) toward the member's pharmacy cost-sharing. Tracked separately as these amounts may not count toward TrOOP under CMS rules.

attributes.name: troop_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative true out-of-pocket (TrOOP) expenditure for Medicare Part D members, counting only qualifying cost-sharing amounts toward the catastrophic coverage threshold. Excludes amounts paid by third parties not qualifying under CMS TrOOP rules. Required for CMS Part D benefit phase determination.

attributes.name: troop_limit_amt
attributes.description: The annual TrOOP threshold amount that, when reached, transitions a Medicare Part D member into catastrophic coverage. Published annually by CMS as part of the Part D benefit parameters.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this accumulator record was most recently modified, reflecting the latest claim adjudication event or manual adjustment. Supports concurrency control and audit trail.

attributes.name: vreq_validated
attributes.description: Marker indicating VREQ validation pass

products.name: pharmacy_contract
products.description: Contractual record governing the reimbursement terms between the health plan (or PBM on its behalf) and individual dispensing pharmacies or pharmacy chains. Captures pharmacy NPI, network tier (preferred/standard/specialty), dispensing fee schedule, ingredient cost basis (AWP discount/MAC/WAC), effective date range, contract type (direct/PBM-administered), performance requirements, and audit provisions. Distinct from pbm_contract which governs the PBM relationship. [FHIR-aligned]

attributes.name: pharmacy_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the pharmacy contract record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: dispensing_pharmacy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dispensing pharmacy or pharmacy chain entity in the pharmacy master. Links this contract to the specific pharmacy party.

attributes.name: mac_list_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the MAC pricing list applied under this contract for generic and multi-source drug reimbursement. References the specific MAC schedule version used by the PBM or health plan. Applicable when ingredient_cost_basis is mac.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract under which this pharmacy dispensing agreement is administered, when the contract is PBM-administered rather than direct. Null for direct health-plan contracts.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.provider_network. Business justification: Contracts are negotiated per network; linking contracts to provider_network enables contract‑level reporting, tiering, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: accreditation_type
attributes.description: Type of accreditation required or held by the pharmacy under this contract. URAC and ACHC are common for specialty pharmacies. PCAB (Pharmacy Compounding Accreditation Board) for compounding pharmacies. Relevant for specialty and mail-order contracts.

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Contractually stipulated frequency at which the health plan or PBM may conduct pharmacy audits. Applicable when audit_rights_indicator is true.

attributes.name: audit_rights_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health plan or PBM retains the right to conduct on-site or desk audits of the pharmacy's dispensing records under this contract. Required for CMS Part D compliance.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract automatically renews at the end of the contract term unless either party provides notice of termination within the required notice period.

attributes.name: awp_discount_pct
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage applied to the drug's Average Wholesale Price (AWP) to determine ingredient cost reimbursement for brand and generic drugs. Expressed as a positive percentage (e.g., 16.50 = AWP minus 16.50%). Applicable when ingredient_cost_basis is awp_discount.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract reference number assigned by the health plan or PBM. Used in correspondence, audits, and regulatory filings. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this agreement.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pharmacy contract. Active contracts are eligible for claim adjudication. Suspended contracts are temporarily ineligible. Terminated/expired contracts are closed. Drives network eligibility checks in RxClaim/Argus.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contractual relationship: direct (health plan contracts directly with pharmacy), pbm_administered (PBM manages on plan's behalf), chain (multi-location chain agreement), independent (single-location independent pharmacy), mail_order, or specialty. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct|pbm_administered|chain|independent|mail_order|specialty — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: credentialing_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy must complete and maintain credentialing requirements (state licensure, DEA registration, accreditation) as a condition of this contract.

attributes.name: days_supply_mail_max
attributes.description: Maximum days supply per mail-order prescription fill authorized under this contract (typically 90 days). Drives adjudication edits in RxClaim/Argus.

attributes.name: days_supply_retail_max
