attributes.description: Maximum days supply per retail prescription fill authorized under this contract (typically 30 or 34 days). Claims exceeding this limit may be rejected during adjudication.

attributes.name: dispensing_channel
attributes.description: The dispensing channel(s) authorized under this contract. Retail covers walk-in pharmacies; mail_order covers 90-day supply dispensing; specialty covers high-cost/complex drugs; long_term_care covers SNF/LTC facilities; home_infusion covers IV therapy.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_mail_order
attributes.description: Contracted flat dispensing fee (in USD) paid per mail-order prescription dispensed. Typically lower than retail due to higher volume and automation. Applicable for mail-order and specialty pharmacy contracts.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_retail
attributes.description: Contracted flat dispensing fee (in USD) paid to the pharmacy per retail prescription dispensed, in addition to ingredient cost reimbursement. A core financial term of the pharmacy contract.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_specialty
attributes.description: Contracted flat dispensing fee (in USD) paid per specialty drug prescription dispensed. Specialty drugs require enhanced clinical services, justifying a separate fee schedule.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy contract becomes binding and the pharmacy is eligible to dispense claims under this agreement. Used for network eligibility validation during adjudication.

attributes.name: executed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy contract was fully executed (signed by all parties). May precede the effective_date if there is a future start date.

attributes.name: generic_awp_discount_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted AWP discount percentage specifically for generic drugs, which typically carries a deeper discount than brand drugs. Expressed as a positive percentage. Applicable when ingredient_cost_basis is awp_discount and a separate generic rate is negotiated.

tag_set.value: Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage

attributes.name: generic_dispensing_rate_target
attributes.description: Contracted minimum generic dispensing rate (GDR) the pharmacy must achieve as a performance requirement. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 85.00 = 85%). Supports CMS Part D Star Ratings and cost management objectives.

attributes.name: ingredient_cost_basis
attributes.description: The pricing methodology used to calculate ingredient cost reimbursement to the pharmacy. AWP (Average Wholesale Price) discount, MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost), WAC (Wholesale Acquisition Cost) discount, NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost), or Usual and Customary (U&C). Core reimbursement term in the contract.

attributes.name: last_amended_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment or addendum to this pharmacy contract. Used to track contract evolution and ensure the current fee schedule and terms are applied during adjudication.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The line of business to which this pharmacy contract applies. Determines applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., CMS Part D rules for Medicare, state Medicaid rules). A contract may be scoped to one or multiple LOBs.

attributes.name: mail_order_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy is authorized to dispense mail-order (90-day supply) prescriptions under this contract.

attributes.name: ncpdp_provider_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Provider ID
attributes.description: 7-digit NCPDP pharmacy identifier used in pharmacy claim transactions (NCPDP Telecom D.0) and PBM adjudication. Complements the NPI for pharmacy-specific identification.

tag_set.value: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Provider ID

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Network participation tier assigned to the pharmacy under this contract. Preferred pharmacies typically offer lower member cost-sharing. Drives member cost-sharing calculations and formulary benefit design.

attributes.name: part_d_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy contract is applicable to Medicare Part D prescription drug benefit administration. When true, CMS Part D network adequacy, pricing, and reporting requirements apply.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes performance guarantees (e.g., generic dispensing rate, medication adherence, fill accuracy). When true, performance_guarantee_details apply.

attributes.name: pharmacy_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned to the dispensing pharmacy by CMS. Used for claims adjudication, EDI transactions (NCPDP 5.1/D.0), and network directory publication.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pharmacy contract record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pharmacy contract record was most recently updated in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for change detection, incremental processing, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: recoupment_provision_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes provisions allowing the health plan or PBM to recoup overpayments identified through audits or claims reviews.

attributes.name: source_system_contract_code
attributes.description: Native contract identifier from the originating PBM system (RxClaim or Argus) or provider management system (Cactus/ProviderSource). Used for lineage tracing and reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational systems.

attributes.name: specialty_drug_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy is contracted and credentialed to dispense specialty drugs under this agreement. Specialty pharmacies must meet enhanced accreditation requirements (URAC, ACHC).

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the primary state jurisdiction governing this pharmacy contract. Determines applicable state DOI regulations, MAC transparency laws, and pharmacy contracting statutes.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy contract ends or was terminated. Null for open-ended contracts. Claims with service dates after this date are not eligible for reimbursement under this contract.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days advance written notice required by either party to terminate the contract without cause. Regulatory minimums vary by state DOI requirements.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the pharmacy contract document (e.g., v1.0, v2.1, Amendment 3). Tracks contract amendments and renegotiations over time for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: wac_discount_pct
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage applied to the drug's Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) for ingredient cost reimbursement. Applicable when ingredient_cost_basis is wac_discount.

domains.name: billing
domains.description: Single source of truth for premium billing and revenue collection — group invoicing, individual premium statements, payment processing, grace periods, retroactive adjustments, premium reconciliation, refunds, and collections. Owns APR rate structures, PMPM calculations, subsidy and APTC tracking for ACA members, and accounts receivable. Supports CMS premium remittance and state DOI financial reporting. Source system: HealthEdge or custom billing platform.

products.name: premium_invoice
products.description: Core billing document representing a premium invoice or statement issued to an employer group, individual member (IFP/ACA marketplace direct-pay), COBRA qualified beneficiary, or government sponsor for a specific billing period. Captures invoice number, billing period start/end, total premium due, subsidy/APTC amounts applied, net amount due, invoice status (draft, issued, paid, partially paid, void, delinquent), due date, document type (group list-bill invoice, group self-bill invoice, individual member statement, COBRA invoice, government remittance request), delivery method (mail, email, member portal), line-of-business (LOB), statement-specific fields for IFP direct-pay members (statement number, member reference, plan name, statement delivery preference), and source system reference from HealthEdge or custom billing platform. SSOT for ALL premium billing documents — both group invoices and individual member statements — in the billing domain. [FHIR-aligned]

products.name: pa_decision
products.description: Transactional record capturing the authorization decision and underlying medical necessity determination rendered on a PA request. Stores decision date, decision type (approved, denied, partially approved, pended, withdrawn), clinical criteria applied (InterQual/MCG criteria set, version, effective date), criteria met/not met flag, clinical rationale narrative, ICD diagnosis codes supporting the determination, deciding reviewer NPI and credentials (MD, RN, PharmD), denial reason code and category (medical necessity, administrative, benefit exclusion, out-of-network, experimental/investigational), denial regulatory citation, appeal eligibility flag, and effective authorization period (start/end dates). Each PA request may have one or more decision records reflecting amendments, P2P reversals, or appeal overrides. Serves as the single evidentiary record for NCQA audits, state DOI market conduct exams, and denial defense. [FHIR-aligned]

products.description: Manages inpatient concurrent review records for admitted members — the ongoing UM review process evaluating continued medical necessity during a hospital stay. attributes.description: ABA routing transit number for the general agent's bank account used for ACH commission disbursements.

attributes.name: business_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the general agent's primary business mailing address. Used for commission check mailing, regulatory correspondence, and contract delivery.

attributes.name: business_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the general agent's primary business mailing address (suite, floor, unit number).

attributes.name: business_city
attributes.description: City of the general agent's primary business address.

attributes.name: business_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the general agent's primary business address. Typically USA for domestic health insurance operations.

attributes.name: business_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code for the general agent's primary business address. Used for state-specific regulatory compliance and commission tax reporting.

attributes.name: business_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the general agent's primary business address.

attributes.name: cms_certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the general agent completed CMS-required certification for Medicare Advantage and/or Part D product distribution.

attributes.name: commission_payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which commission payments are disbursed to the general agent. Drives payment processing routing in the financial system.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the commission schedule applicable to this general agent. Determines commission rates, override structures, and bonus eligibility for group sales and renewals.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the general agent's distribution contract with the health plan became effective. Governs commission schedules, book-of-business rights, and service obligations.

attributes.name: contract_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the general agent's distribution contract with the health plan expires or is scheduled for renewal. Null for evergreen contracts.

attributes.name: contract_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the general agent's contract is scheduled for renewal review. Used by the producer management team to initiate renewal negotiations.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade name or 'doing business as' name used by the general agent in market-facing activities, if different from the legal name.

attributes.name: e_o_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability coverage maintained by the general agent. Must meet minimum thresholds set by the health plan's appointment requirements.

attributes.name: e_o_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the general agent's E&O professional liability insurance policy expires. Used to trigger renewal reminders and flag compliance gaps.

attributes.name: e_o_insurance_carrier
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier providing Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability coverage for the general agent. Required as a condition of appointment.

attributes.name: e_o_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for the general agent's Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability insurance policy.

attributes.name: ga_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier assigned to the general agent by the health plan or carrier. Used in downstream systems, commission statements, and regulatory filings to uniquely reference the GA.

attributes.name: is_aca_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the general agent has completed required ACA marketplace training and certification for individual and small group exchange product sales.

attributes.name: is_cms_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the general agent has completed CMS-required training and certification for Medicare Advantage and/or Part D product sales. Required for MA/PDP distribution.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health insurance line of business for which the general agent is contracted to distribute products. Determines applicable regulatory requirements and commission structures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare_advantage|medicaid|dental|vision|life|disability — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Health insurance market segment(s) in which the general agent is authorized to sell on behalf of the health plan. Drives product availability and commission schedule applicability.

attributes.name: general_agent_name
attributes.description: Full legal business name of the general agent organization as registered with the state insurance department. Used for contracts, commission payments, and regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: National Producer Number assigned by the NIPR (National Insurance Producer Registry) to uniquely identify the general agent across all states. Used for license verification and regulatory reporting. Note: field named 'npi' per industry convention for producer identification.

attributes.name: npn
attributes.description: National Producer Number (NPN) as assigned by the National Insurance Producer Registry (NIPR). Primary cross-state identifier for producer licensing verification and CMS reporting for Medicare/Medicaid lines of business.

attributes.name: ofac_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent OFAC sanctions screening was performed for the general agent.

attributes.name: ofac_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the OFAC (Office of Foreign Assets Control) sanctions screening for the general agent. Required to ensure the health plan does not conduct business with sanctioned entities.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the primary contact at the general agent organization. Used for commission statements, contract communications, and compliance notifications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the general agent organization for day-to-day operational communications with the health plan.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number of the primary contact at the general agent organization.

attributes.name: primary_contact_title
attributes.description: Job title of the primary contact at the general agent organization (e.g., President, Director of Sales, Account Manager).

attributes.name: primary_state_license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the general agent's primary state insurance producer license expires. Used to trigger renewal reminders and suspend commission eligibility for unlicensed agents.

attributes.name: primary_state_license_number
attributes.description: Insurance producer license number issued by the general agent's primary state of domicile. Required for appointment processing and regulatory compliance verification.

attributes.name: primary_state_license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code for the state in which the general agent holds their primary insurance producer license (state of domicile).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the general agent record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the general agent record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: service_area_states
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of two-letter state codes representing the states in which the general agent is authorized to market and sell health plan products. Used for geographic territory management.

attributes.name: general_agent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the general agent relationship with the health plan. Drives eligibility for commission payments, new group submissions, and renewal processing.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) assigned to the general agent by the IRS. Required for commission payments, 1099 reporting, and ACA compliance filings.

attributes.name: w9_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification) is on file for this general agent. Required before commission payments can be issued.

attributes.name: w9_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent IRS Form W-9 was received from the general agent. Used to track compliance with IRS backup withholding requirements.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Public website URL for the general agent organization. Used for producer directory listings and employer group referrals.

attributes.name: supervising_general_agent_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on general_agent (supervising_general_agent_id)

domains.name: contract
domains.description: Manages provider contracts, reimbursement agreements, capitation arrangements, fee schedules, value-based care (VBC) contracts, ACO agreements, risk-sharing models, contract terms, amendments, and contract lifecycle. Tracks contract effective dates, rate tables, and payment methodologies (fee-for-service, capitation, bundled payments). SSOT for all contractual and reimbursement terms between the health plan and providers.

products.name: party
products.description: Identifies all parties bound by a provider contract — the health plan entity, the contracting provider (individual NPI or organizational NPI), group practice, IPA, ACO, or hospital system. Tracks party role (payer, provider, delegated entity), NPI, TIN, legal entity name, signatory authority, and party effective dates. Supports multi-party and delegated contracting arrangements. [FHIR-aligned]

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each party record in the provider contract domain. Serves as the primary key for all contractual party references across the health plan enterprise.

attributes.name: record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credential.credential_record. Business justification: Party represents a provider entity in a contract; linking to its credential record enables tracking of credential status and compliance per party.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Contract Party Management report requires linking party records to vendor master to identify vendor parties (e.g., TPAs) for compliance and payment processing.

attributes.name: aco_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is an Accountable Care Organization (ACO) participating in a value-based care (VBC) arrangement. Triggers ACO-specific contract terms, shared savings calculations, and CMS reporting requirements.

attributes.name: capitation_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is eligible to receive capitation payments (Per Member Per Month - PMPM) under the contract. Drives capitation payment processing and actuarial PMPM rate application.

attributes.name: contract_party_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this party within the contract management system (e.g., Cactus or ProviderSource provider contract number). Used for cross-system reconciliation, EDI transactions, and provider directory publication.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider contract this party is bound by. Links the party record to its governing contractual agreement within the contract domain.

attributes.name: credentialing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party was most recently credentialed or re-credentialed by the health plan. NCQA requires re-credentialing every 36 months. Used to trigger re-credentialing workflows and network compliance reporting.

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing status of the party as maintained in the Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource). Determines whether the party is eligible to provide services to plan members. Credentialing must be current for claims to be adjudicated as in-network.

attributes.name: delegation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is a delegated entity authorized to perform functions on behalf of the health plan (e.g., credentialing, utilization management, claims processing). Triggers delegation oversight and audit requirements per NCQA and state DOI standards.

attributes.name: delegation_scope
attributes.description: Specifies the functional scope of delegation authority granted to this party. Applicable only when delegation_indicator is true. Defines which health plan functions the delegated entity is authorized to perform on behalf of the payer.

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the party operates, if different from the legal entity name. Commonly used for group practices and hospital systems that operate under a brand name distinct from their legal registration.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party's participation in the contract becomes effective. Drives claims adjudication eligibility windows, network directory publication, and provider credentialing timelines.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the contracting party as registered with state or federal authorities. Used for contract execution, credentialing, and regulatory reporting. May be an individual provider name, group practice name, IPA, ACO, or hospital system name.

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party's primary state professional or business license expires. Triggers credentialing re-verification workflows and may result in contract suspension if not renewed. Critical for NCQA and URAC credentialing compliance.

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation where the party holds its primary professional or business license. Used for network adequacy reporting, credentialing, and state-specific regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health plan line of business under which this party is contracted. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, reimbursement methodologies, and network adequacy standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare_advantage|medicaid|marketplace|cobra|fehb — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: malpractice_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party maintains active professional liability (malpractice) insurance coverage as required by the contract. Failure to maintain coverage may trigger contract suspension or termination per NCQA credentialing standards.

attributes.name: malpractice_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party's professional liability (malpractice) insurance policy expires. Triggers credentialing re-verification and contract compliance monitoring workflows.

attributes.name: network_participation_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party is a participating (PAR) in-network provider, a non-participating (non-PAR) provider, or an out-of-network provider. Drives member cost-sharing calculations, claims adjudication rules, and EOB generation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing supplemental information about the party that does not fit structured attributes. May include contract negotiation notes, special arrangement details, or credentialing exceptions. Classified as confidential due to potential inclusion of sensitive business information.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the provider party. Type 1 NPI for individual providers; Type 2 NPI for organizational providers. Required for all HIPAA-covered transactions including 837 claims and 270/271 eligibility inquiries.

attributes.name: npi_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NPI is Type 1 (individual/solo practitioner) or Type 2 (organizational entity such as group practice, hospital, or IPA). Determines credentialing requirements and contract structure.

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party appears on the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE). Excluded parties are prohibited from participating in Medicare, Medicaid, and other federal healthcare programs. Checked monthly per CMS compliance requirements.

tag_set.value: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Indicator

attributes.name: party_role
attributes.description: Functional role of this party within the contract relationship. Identifies whether the party is the health plan (payer), a contracting provider, a delegated entity, an Independent Practice Association (IPA), an Accountable Care Organization (ACO), a hospital system, or a group practice. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: payer|provider|delegated_entity|ipa|aco|hospital_system|group_practice — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: party_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the party within the contract. Indicates whether the party is actively bound by the contract, pending execution, suspended, terminated, or inactive. Drives eligibility verification and claims adjudication routing.

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: Classifies the party as an individual (natural person, e.g., solo practitioner with individual NPI) or an organization (legal entity, e.g., group practice, hospital, IPA, ACO). Drives NPI type assignment and credentialing workflow.

attributes.name: primary_specialty_code
attributes.description: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code representing the party's primary clinical specialty. Used for network adequacy analysis, claims routing, prior authorization rules, and provider directory classification.

attributes.name: raf_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) scoring applies to this party's contract arrangement. Relevant for Medicare Advantage and ACA marketplace contracts where Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk scores drive capitation payments.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change data capture, audit trail, and SCD Type 2 processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the party must complete re-credentialing to maintain active network participation. Calculated as 36 months from the credentialing_date per NCQA standards. Drives automated re-credentialing workflow initiation.

attributes.name: sanction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has an active sanction, exclusion, or adverse action recorded by OIG, SAM, or state licensing boards. A true value triggers contract suspension review and claims payment hold per CMS and HIPAA compliance requirements.

attributes.name: secondary_specialty_code
attributes.description: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code representing the party's secondary clinical specialty, if applicable. Supports multi-specialty provider contracting and network adequacy reporting.

attributes.name: service_area_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation representing the primary state in which this party provides services under the contract. Used for network adequacy reporting, state regulatory compliance, and geographic claims routing.

attributes.name: service_area_zip_code
attributes.description: Primary ZIP code of the party's principal service location. Used for network adequacy geo-mapping, member-to-provider distance calculations, and CMS network adequacy submissions.

attributes.name: signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized individual who signed or has authority to sign the contract on behalf of this party. Required for contract execution validation and legal enforceability. Typically the CEO, CMO, or designated contracting officer.

attributes.name: signatory_title
attributes.description: Official title or position of the authorized signatory (e.g., Chief Executive Officer, Medical Director, Contracting Officer). Validates the authority level of the individual executing the contract on behalf of the party.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this party record originated (e.g., Cactus, ProviderSource, Facets, QNXT). Supports data lineage tracking, reconciliation, and ETL audit in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: source_system_party_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this party record in the originating operational system (e.g., Cactus provider ID, ProviderSource contract party key). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability from the Silver Layer back to the system of record.

attributes.name: state_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued professional or business license number for the contracting party. Required for credentialing verification and network participation. For individual providers, this is the state medical license; for organizations, the state business license or certificate of authority.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party's participation in the contract ends. Null for open-ended or currently active parties. Used to determine network participation windows, claims payment eligibility, and member notification requirements.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number (EIN or SSN) used for payment processing, 1099 reporting, and IRS compliance. Critical for remittance and premium payment routing. Stored as 9-digit numeric string without hyphens.

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_type
attributes.description: Specifies the payment methodology or value-based care arrangement type applicable to this party under the contract. Drives reimbursement calculation logic, risk-sharing model application, and financial reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_for_service|capitation|bundled_payment|shared_savings|global_risk — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vreq_validated
attributes.description: Marker indicating VREQ validation pass

products.name: term
products.description: Defines the specific terms, conditions, obligations, and reimbursement policies within a provider contract. Captures term type (payment methodology, exclusivity, termination clause, audit rights, hold-harmless, indemnification, confidentiality, HIPAA BAA, reimbursement rule), term text, effective date, expiration date, and whether the term is negotiable or standard boilerplate. For reimbursement rule terms: captures policy sub-type (multiple procedure reduction, bilateral procedure, assistant surgeon, global surgery, unbundling rules, place-of-service differential), applicable CPT/HCPCS ranges, reduction percentage, and LOB applicability. Enables granular tracking of contractual obligations, compliance checkpoints, and reimbursement adjudication rules. Bridges contract terms to claims adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT. [FHIR-aligned]

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a contract term record in the provider contract management system (Facets/QNXT or Provider Management System). Serves as the primary key for the term entity.

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contract amendment that introduced or modified this term, if applicable. Null if the term originates from the base contract rather than an amendment.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee schedule associated with this term when payment_methodology is fee_for_service. Links to the rate table governing allowed amounts for procedure codes under this term.

attributes.name: audit_rights_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years the health plan retains the right to audit provider records under this audit rights term. Typically 7 years per HIPAA and CMS requirements. Applicable when term_type is 'audit_rights'.

attributes.name: auto_renew
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term automatically renews upon expiration without requiring renegotiation (True). Supports contract lifecycle management and renewal notification workflows.

attributes.name: capitation_rate
attributes.description: The Per Member Per Month (PMPM) capitation rate defined by this term when payment_methodology is capitation. Represents the fixed monthly payment per enrolled member to the provider regardless of services rendered. Classified confidential as proprietary pricing.

attributes.name: compliance_checkpoint_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next compliance review or audit checkpoint associated with this term. Used by the compliance team to track regulatory obligations, CMS audit readiness, and DOI examination preparation.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent provider contract to which this term belongs. Links the term to its governing contract in the Provider Network Management system.

attributes.name: cpt_range_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range End
attributes.description: The ending CPT or HCPCS procedure code of the range to which this reimbursement rule term applies. Used in conjunction with cpt_range_start to define the applicable procedure code range for adjudication.

tag_set.value: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range End

attributes.name: cpt_range_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range Start
attributes.description: The starting CPT or HCPCS procedure code of the range to which this reimbursement rule term applies. Used in conjunction with cpt_range_end to define the applicable procedure code range for adjudication.

tag_set.value: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range Start

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract term record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record retention requirements.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: The contractually agreed method for resolving disputes arising under this term: Arbitration, Mediation, Litigation, or Internal Review. Applicable for hold-harmless, indemnification, and audit rights terms.

attributes.name: drg_grouper_version
attributes.description: The DRG grouper version (e.g., 'MS-DRG v41.0', 'APR-DRG v39') applicable to this term when payment_methodology is 'drg_based'. Ensures adjudication uses the correct DRG weight tables for inpatient reimbursement.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this contract term becomes legally binding and operationally enforceable. Used to determine applicability during claims adjudication in Facets/QNXT.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this contract term ceases to be binding. Null for open-ended terms with no defined end date. Used in adjudication date-range checks.

attributes.name: governing_state
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code whose laws govern this contract term. Determines applicable state DOI regulations, insurance code requirements, and state-specific provider contract mandates.

attributes.name: hipaa_baa_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term constitutes or requires a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) (True). Triggers compliance tracking and ensures Protected Health Information (PHI) handling obligations are documented per HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.

tag_set.value: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Required Indicator

attributes.name: icd_version
attributes.description: Specifies the ICD diagnosis coding version applicable to this term when the term references diagnosis-based reimbursement rules or Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk adjustment provisions.

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount of quality incentive payment available to the provider under this term upon meeting quality_metric_threshold. Applicable for VBC, ACO, and pay-for-performance contract terms. Classified confidential as proprietary financial terms.

attributes.name: is_adjudication_rule
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term directly drives claims adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT (True). When True, the term's reimbursement_policy_subtype, cpt_range_start/end, and reduction_percentage are loaded into the adjudication engine.

attributes.name: is_negotiable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract term is open to negotiation (True) or is standard non-negotiable boilerplate language (False). Supports contract negotiation workflow and template management.

attributes.name: is_standard_boilerplate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term is sourced from the organization's standard contract template library (True) or is a custom-negotiated term specific to this contract (False). Supports template governance and deviation tracking.

attributes.name: lob_applicability
attributes.description: Specifies which Line of Business (LOB) this contract term applies to. Enables selective application of reimbursement rules and contractual obligations across Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Marketplace (ACA/QHP), or all lines of business.

attributes.name: mac_pricing_basis
attributes.description: The drug pricing benchmark used for pharmacy reimbursement terms: Average Wholesale Price (AWP), Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC), Maximum Allowable Cost (MAC), National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC), or a custom contracted rate. Applicable for terms covering pharmacy benefits.

attributes.name: payment_methodology
attributes.description: The reimbursement payment methodology defined by this term when term_type is 'payment_methodology' or 'reimbursement_rule'. Drives adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT. Includes Fee-for-Service (FFS), Capitation, Bundled Payment, Case Rate, Per Diem, Diagnosis Related Group (DRG)-based, Reference Based Pricing (RBP), and Value-Based Care (VBC). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_for_service|capitation|bundled_payment|case_rate|per_diem|drg_based|rbp|vbc — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pos_code
attributes.description: The CMS Place of Service (POS) code to which this term's reimbursement differential applies, when reimbursement_policy_subtype is 'pos_differential'. Two-digit code per CMS POS code set (e.g., '11' for Office, '21' for Inpatient Hospital).

attributes.name: quality_metric_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum quality performance threshold (expressed as a percentage or score) that the provider must achieve to qualify for incentive payments or avoid penalties under quality incentive terms. Linked to HEDIS or STAR measures.

attributes.name: reduction_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage reduction applied to the allowed amount under this reimbursement rule term (e.g., 50.00 for a 50% reduction on secondary procedures under multiple procedure reduction policy). Applicable when reimbursement_policy_subtype is set. Classified confidential as it represents proprietary pricing.

attributes.name: reimbursement_policy_subtype
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification of the reimbursement rule when term_type is 'reimbursement_rule'. Specifies the specific adjudication policy: Multiple Procedure Reduction, Bilateral Procedure, Assistant Surgeon, Global Surgery, Unbundling Rules, Place-of-Service (POS) Differential, or Modifier Impact. Directly maps to adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: multiple_procedure_reduction|bilateral_procedure|assistant_surgeon|global_surgery|unbundling|pos_differential|modifier_impact — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days prior to expiration_date by which either party must provide notice of intent not to renew this term. Applicable when auto_renew is True.

attributes.name: risk_sharing_model
attributes.description: Defines the risk-sharing arrangement under Value-Based Care (VBC) or Accountable Care Organization (ACO) contract terms. Specifies whether the provider participates in shared savings only (upside), shared risk (two-sided), or full risk (global capitation).

attributes.name: source_system_term_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this term record in the originating operational system (e.g., Cactus contract clause ID, QNXT reimbursement rule ID, or ProviderSource term reference). Supports data lineage and reconciliation with source systems.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Plain-language operational summary of the term's intent and impact, authored by the contracting team. Used for training, audits, and quick reference without reading full legal text.

attributes.name: term_number
attributes.description: Human-readable external identifier for the term, typically formatted as a section or clause reference (e.g., 'TERM-2024-0042' or 'Section 4.2.1'). Used in contract documents and correspondence.

attributes.name: term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the contract term. 'active' indicates the term is currently in force; 'superseded' indicates it has been replaced by an amendment; 'expired' indicates the effective period has lapsed.

attributes.name: term_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the contract term defining its legal or operational purpose. Drives downstream adjudication logic and compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reimbursement_rule|payment_methodology|exclusivity|termination_clause|audit_rights|hold_harmless|indemnification|confidentiality|hipaa_baa|quality_incentive — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: termination_cause_type
attributes.description: Specifies the basis under which termination is permitted by this term: For Cause (material breach, fraud, license revocation), Without Cause (convenience), Mutual Agreement, or Regulatory (required by law or CMS/DOI directive).

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days of advance written notice required to terminate the contract under this termination clause term. Applicable when term_type is 'termination_clause'. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Full verbatim legal text of the contract term as negotiated and executed. Contains the binding contractual language. Classified confidential as it represents proprietary reimbursement and legal obligations.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the contract term as it appears in the contract document (e.g., 'Multiple Procedure Reduction Policy', 'Termination for Cause Clause'). Supports search and display in contract management UIs.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract term record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.

attributes.name: vreq_validated
attributes.description: Marker indicating VREQ validation pass

attributes.name: withhold_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of reimbursement withheld from provider payments pending quality performance or risk settlement under VBC or capitation arrangements. Classified confidential as proprietary financial terms.

products.name: amendment
products.description: [SSOT:amendment] Single source of truth (canonical) for the 'amendment' concept. Tracks all formal amendments, addenda, and modifications to an existing provider contract. Captures amendment number, amendment type (rate change, term modification, LOB addition, network tier change), effective date, reason for amendment, negotiation outcome, approval status, and the specific contract sections modified. Maintains full amendment history for audit and compliance purposes. SSOT NOTE: This product is the single source of truth (canonical) for the 'amendment' concept across domains. [FHIR-aligned] Designated SSOT for the amendment concept.

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each provider contract amendment record. Primary key for the amendment entity.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Needed for Amendment Approval audit; ties each amendment to the employee who approved it, satisfying compliance tracking.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee schedule record activated or superseded by this amendment. Links the amendment to the specific rate table used for claims adjudication under the amended terms.

attributes.name: regulatory_change_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_change. Business justification: Required: Amendments are often triggered by regulatory changes; linking tracks the change that caused the amendment.

attributes.name: superseded_amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to a prior amendment record that this amendment replaces or supersedes. Enables traversal of the full amendment history chain for a given contract. Null if this is the first amendment or does not supersede a prior amendment.

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated Accountable Care Organization (ACO) agreement when this amendment relates to an ACO or Value-Based Care (VBC) arrangement. Nullable for non-ACO amendments.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable sequential identifier for the amendment (e.g., AMD-2024-001234-001). Used in correspondence, audit trails, and regulatory submissions. Unique within the parent contract.

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the amendment indicating the nature of the modification. Drives downstream processing workflows and audit categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rate_change|term_modification|lob_addition|network_tier_change|scope_change|termination|capitation_change|bundled_payment_change|vbc_modification|addendum — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the amendment through the negotiation and approval workflow. Tracks progression from draft through execution or withdrawal.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the amendment received final internal approval from all required approvers. Distinct from execution date which reflects provider countersignature.

attributes.name: capitation_rate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: The Per Member Per Month (PMPM) capitation rate established or modified by this amendment for capitation-based payment arrangements. Applicable when payment_methodology is capitation. Confidential commercial negotiation data.

tag_set.value: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)

attributes.name: claims_reprocess_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether claims adjudicated under prior contract terms must be reprocessed following execution of this amendment. Triggers downstream claims reprocessing workflows in Facets/QNXT.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent provider contract that this amendment modifies. Links the amendment to its originating contract record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the amendment record was first created in the contract management system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the executed amendment document stored in the contract management document repository (e.g., SharePoint, Cactus/ProviderSource document store). Enables direct access to the legal document.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the terms of this amendment become contractually binding and operationally effective. Used for rate table activation, benefit configuration updates, and claims adjudication rule changes.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which all required parties formally signed and executed the amendment document. May differ from the effective date for retroactive or prospective amendments.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the amendment terms cease to be effective. Nullable for permanent amendments with no defined end date. Used to manage time-limited rate changes or temporary term modifications.

attributes.name: formulary_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment affects pharmacy formulary terms, drug reimbursement rates, or Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) arrangements. Triggers updates to the PBM system (RxClaim/Argus).

attributes.name: initiating_party
attributes.description: Identifies which party initiated the amendment request — the health plan, the provider, a regulatory mandate, or a mutual agreement. Used for negotiation analytics and contract management reporting.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal health plan staff notes regarding the amendment, including strategic context, escalation history, or implementation considerations. Confidential internal business information not shared with providers.

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: Identifies the Line of Business (LOB) affected by this amendment (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, CHIP, Exchange/QHP). Critical for segregating contractual terms by regulatory program.

attributes.name: negotiation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative capturing key negotiation points, concessions, and outcomes during the amendment negotiation process. Confidential commercial information used for internal reference and future renegotiation strategy.

attributes.name: negotiation_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the contract negotiation process leading to this amendment. Indicates whether terms were mutually agreed, required counter-proposals, or were resolved through arbitration or mediation. Confidential commercial negotiation data.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: The provider network tier designation established or modified by this amendment (e.g., Tier 1 preferred, Tier 2 standard, Tier 3 specialty). Affects member cost-sharing and provider reimbursement rates.

attributes.name: payment_methodology
attributes.description: The reimbursement methodology established or modified by this amendment. Determines how providers are compensated under the amended contract terms. Aligns with Value-Based Care (VBC), Reference Based Pricing (RBP), capitation, or Fee-For-Service (FFS) models. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_for_service|capitation|bundled_payment|per_diem|case_rate|vbc|rbp — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_signatory_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized representative of the health plan who executed the amendment on behalf of the health plan. Required for legal enforceability of the amendment.

attributes.name: prior_auth_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment modifies Prior Authorization (PA) requirements for services rendered by the provider. Triggers updates to Utilization Management (UM) system configurations in InterQual/MCG.

attributes.name: provider_signatory_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized representative of the provider organization who executed the amendment on behalf of the provider. Required for legal enforceability of the amendment.

attributes.name: rate_change_pct
attributes.description: The percentage increase or decrease in reimbursement rates resulting from this amendment. Expressed as a signed decimal (positive for increases, negative for decreases). Applicable when amendment_type is rate_change. Confidential commercial negotiation data.

attributes.name: rate_effective_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which revised reimbursement rates established by this amendment take effect in the claims adjudication system. May differ from the overall amendment effective date for phased implementations.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of the business rationale or triggering event for the amendment (e.g., annual rate renegotiation, regulatory mandate, network expansion, provider request). Supports audit and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment was required by a regulatory mandate (e.g., CMS rate update, state DOI directive, ACA compliance requirement). Drives prioritization and compliance reporting workflows.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the specific regulation, CMS bulletin, state DOI directive, or legislative act that mandated or triggered this amendment (e.g., 'CMS-2024-MA-Rate-Update', 'ACA Section 1302'). Populated when regulatory_mandate_flag is true.

attributes.name: retroactive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amendment has a retroactive effective date that precedes the execution date. Retroactive amendments require claims reprocessing and financial reconciliation activities.

attributes.name: retroactive_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest date from which retroactive amendment terms apply, when retroactive_flag is true. Defines the claims reprocessing window for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: risk_share_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of financial risk shared between the health plan and the provider under risk-sharing or Value-Based Care (VBC) arrangements established by this amendment. Confidential commercial negotiation data.

attributes.name: sections_modified
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list or narrative description of the specific contract sections, exhibits, or schedules modified by this amendment (e.g., 'Exhibit A - Fee Schedule, Section 4.2 - Term'). Supports targeted audit and compliance review.

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the amendment was formally submitted for internal review and approval. Marks the start of the amendment approval workflow.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title summarizing the purpose of the amendment (e.g., '2024 Annual Rate Increase — Hospital Services'). Used in contract management dashboards and correspondence.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the amendment record was most recently modified in the contract management system. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: vbc_target_metric
attributes.description: The primary quality or cost performance metric targeted under a Value-Based Care (VBC) or Accountable Care Organization (ACO) arrangement established by this amendment (e.g., HEDIS measure, readmission rate, cost per episode). Applicable when payment_methodology is vbc.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version counter tracking revisions to the amendment record during the drafting and negotiation process. Supports amendment history and audit trail requirements.

products.name: fee_schedule
products.description: Master fee schedule defining reimbursement rates for covered services under a provider contract. Captures fee schedule name, version, effective and termination dates, payment basis (% of Medicare, % of billed charges, flat rate, RVU-based), geographic modifier applicability, LOB scope, and fee schedule type (professional, institutional, ancillary, DME, lab). SSOT for all fee-for-service reimbursement rates. Sourced from Facets/QNXT Benefits Configuration. [FHIR-aligned]

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the fee schedule record in the contract domain. Primary key for the fee_schedule data product.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific health plan or benefit plan to which this fee schedule is scoped. Enables plan-level fee schedule assignment in Facets/QNXT Benefits Configuration.

attributes.name: practice_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider or provider group for whom this fee schedule defines reimbursement rates. Sourced from the Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource).

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider network (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, POS) to which this fee schedule applies. Determines in-network vs. out-of-network reimbursement applicability.

attributes.name: risk_pool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.pool. Business justification: RATE_DEVELOPMENT: Fee schedules are applied within a specific risk pool; linking enables actuarial rate calculations and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: superseded_by_fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee_schedule_id of the newer fee schedule that replaced this one when schedule_status is 'superseded'. Enables fee schedule version chain navigation and historical rate lookups.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the contract amendment that introduced or modified this fee schedule version. Null for the original fee schedule. Enables traceability between fee schedule versions and contract amendments.

attributes.name: anesthesia_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee schedule includes anesthesia service reimbursement, which uses base units plus time units multiplied by a conversion factor rather than standard CPT-based rates.

attributes.name: anesthesia_conversion_factor
attributes.description: Dollar amount per anesthesia unit (base units + time units) used to calculate anesthesia reimbursement when anesthesia_applicable is True. Negotiated rate specific to this fee schedule.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee schedule was formally approved by the authorized contracting officer or governance body. Required for audit and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: cms_fee_schedule_year
attributes.description: The CMS Medicare fee schedule calendar year used as the basis or benchmark for this fee schedule when fee_schedule_source is 'cms_medicare'. Enables tracking of which CMS annual update cycle the rates are derived from.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider contract under which this fee schedule is established. Links the fee schedule to its governing contractual agreement.

attributes.name: conversion_factor
attributes.description: Dollar amount multiplied by the total Relative Value Units (RVUs) to calculate the reimbursement amount for RVU-based fee schedules. Applicable when payment_basis is 'rvu_based'. Sourced from CMS RBRVS conversion factor or negotiated contract rate.

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Coordination of Benefits (COB) rules apply to claims adjudicated under this fee schedule. When True, COB logic determines primary vs. secondary payer responsibilities.

attributes.name: cpt_code_range_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) Code Range End
attributes.description: Ending CPT procedure code in the range of services covered by this fee schedule. Used in conjunction with cpt_code_range_start to define the scope of applicable procedure codes.

tag_set.value: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) Code Range End

attributes.name: cpt_code_range_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) Code Range Start
attributes.description: Starting CPT procedure code in the range of services covered by this fee schedule. Used in conjunction with cpt_code_range_end to define the scope of applicable procedure codes. Null if the fee schedule applies to all CPT codes or uses ICD/DRG-based scoping.

tag_set.value: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) Code Range Start

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fee schedule record was first created in the system. Audit field capturing the initial record creation event in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the fee schedule, including its purpose, scope, special provisions, or notes relevant to adjudication staff and contract analysts.

attributes.name: drg_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee schedule uses Diagnosis Related Group (DRG)-based reimbursement for inpatient facility claims. When True, DRG weights and base rates govern payment rather than individual procedure codes.

attributes.name: drg_base_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated base dollar rate per DRG weight unit used for inpatient facility reimbursement when drg_applicable is True. Multiplied by the DRG relative weight to calculate the total inpatient payment.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee schedule becomes effective and applicable for claim adjudication and reimbursement calculations. Inclusive start date of the fee schedule validity period.

attributes.name: geographic_modifier_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic adjustment factors (e.g., CMS Geographic Practice Cost Indices - GPCI) are applied to rates under this fee schedule. True when locality-based adjustments are in effect; False for flat national rates.

attributes.name: global_surgery_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether global surgery payment rules apply under this fee schedule, bundling pre-operative, intra-operative, and post-operative services into a single reimbursement amount.

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: Identifies the Line of Business (LOB) to which this fee schedule applies (e.g., commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, ACA Marketplace, COBRA, FEHB). Determines which member populations and plan types are subject to this fee schedule during adjudication.

attributes.name: locality_code
attributes.description: CMS Medicare locality code identifying the geographic pricing area applicable to this fee schedule when geographic_modifier_applicable is True. Used to apply GPCI adjustments to RVU-based rates.

attributes.name: medicare_crossover_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee schedule applies to Medicare crossover claims where Medicare is the primary payer and the health plan is the secondary payer. Relevant for Medicare Advantage and Medigap plans.

attributes.name: modifier_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether CPT or HCPCS modifiers affect reimbursement rates under this fee schedule (e.g., modifier 26 for professional component, modifier TC for technical component, modifier 50 for bilateral procedures).

attributes.name: outlier_threshold_amt
attributes.description: Dollar threshold above which a claim qualifies as a cost outlier, triggering additional reimbursement beyond the standard DRG or bundled payment. Applicable for institutional fee schedules with outlier payment provisions.

attributes.name: payment_basis
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate reimbursement amounts under this fee schedule. Options include: pct_medicare (percentage of Medicare allowable), pct_billed_charges (percentage of provider billed charges), flat_rate (fixed dollar amount per service), rvu_based (Relative Value Unit-based), bundled (bundled payment for episode of care), capitation (per-member per-month), rbp (Reference Based Pricing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pct_medicare|pct_billed_charges|flat_rate|rvu_based|bundled|capitation|rbp — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_basis_pct
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied when payment_basis is 'pct_medicare' or 'pct_billed_charges' (e.g., 110.0000 for 110% of Medicare). Null when payment_basis is flat_rate, rvu_based, bundled, or capitation. Stored as a decimal percentage value.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Prior Authorization (PA) is required for services reimbursed under this fee schedule. When True, claims must have an approved PA on file before adjudication at the scheduled rates.

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a primary care physician (PCP) referral is required for services covered under this fee schedule. Applicable primarily for HMO and POS plan types.

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the fee schedule within the Core Administration Platform (Facets/QNXT). Used in EDI transactions and cross-system references.

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name identifying the fee schedule (e.g., 'Commercial PPO Professional 2024', 'Medicare Advantage Institutional Q1 2024'). Used for display and reporting in Facets/QNXT Benefits Configuration.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fee schedule. 'draft' indicates under review; 'active' indicates currently in use for adjudication; 'suspended' indicates temporarily inactive; 'terminated' indicates permanently closed; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the fee schedule by the type of services covered: professional (physician/practitioner), institutional (hospital/facility), ancillary (therapy/home health), DME (Durable Medical Equipment), lab (laboratory), or pharmacy. Drives claim adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT.

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Broad clinical or administrative category of services covered by this fee schedule (e.g., 'Evaluation and Management', 'Surgery', 'Radiology', 'Pathology', 'Inpatient Facility', 'Outpatient Facility', 'Home Health', 'Behavioral Health'). Supports fee schedule segmentation and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: evaluation_management|surgery|radiology|pathology|inpatient_facility|outpatient_facility|home_health|behavioral_health|physical_therapy|dme — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Identifies the origin or benchmark source of the fee schedule rates: cms_medicare (based on CMS Medicare fee schedule), cms_medicaid (based on state Medicaid fee schedule), negotiated (directly negotiated with provider), custom (health plan proprietary rates), rbp_benchmark (Reference Based Pricing benchmark).

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code indicating the geographic scope of this fee schedule. Used for state-specific rate variations and regulatory compliance with State Departments of Insurance (DOI) requirements.

attributes.name: stop_loss_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a stop-loss provision applies to this fee schedule, capping the health plan's reimbursement liability per claim or per member. Relevant for risk-sharing and capitation arrangements.

attributes.name: stop_loss_threshold_amt
attributes.description: Dollar amount per claim or per member above which the stop-loss provision activates, limiting the health plan's reimbursement exposure. Applicable when stop_loss_applicable is True.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee schedule expires and is no longer applicable for claim adjudication. Null indicates an open-ended fee schedule with no defined end date.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fee schedule record was last modified. Audit field supporting change tracking, data lineage, and regulatory audit requirements.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the fee schedule, enabling tracking of amendments and updates over time (e.g., '1.0', '2.1', '3.0'). Incremented when rates or terms are modified. Supports fee schedule history and audit trail.

products.name: fee_schedule_rate
products.description: Line-level reimbursement rates within a fee schedule. Each record defines the allowed amount or rate for a specific procedure code (CPT/HCPCS), revenue code, DRG, or service category. Captures procedure code, modifier, place of service, allowed amount, MAC/AWP/WAC reference, RBP rate, effective date, and rate derivation method. Enables adjudication systems to price claims against contracted rates. [FHIR-aligned]

attributes.name: fee_schedule_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fee schedule rate line record in the contract domain. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fee schedule header that this rate line belongs to. Links the rate to its governing fee schedule agreement.

attributes.name: prior_rate_fee_schedule_rate_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the previous version of this rate record that was superseded by the current record. Enables full rate history chain traversal for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: allowed_amount
attributes.description: The contracted allowed amount or maximum reimbursable dollar amount for the specified procedure code, modifier, and place of service combination. This is the principal monetary value used by adjudication systems to price claims against contracted rates. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: awp_percent
attributes.description: When rate_derivation_method is AWP_PCT, this field stores the percentage of the Average Wholesale Price (AWP) used to derive the drug or supply reimbursement rate. For example, 0.8500 represents AWP minus 15%. Commonly used in pharmacy and DME fee schedules.

attributes.name: bilateral_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate applies to a bilateral procedure (performed on both sides of the body). When true, the allowed amount may be adjusted per CMS bilateral surgery payment rules (150% of the unilateral rate).

attributes.name: bundled_payment_amount
attributes.description: Single episode-of-care payment amount covering all services within a defined clinical episode (e.g., joint replacement, maternity). Applicable when payment_methodology is BUNDLED. Supports Value-Based Care (VBC) and ACO payment models.

attributes.name: capitation_rate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Fixed monthly payment per enrolled member paid to a provider under a capitation arrangement, regardless of services rendered. Expressed as a Per Member Per Month (PMPM) dollar amount. Applicable only when payment_methodology is CAPITATION.

tag_set.value: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider contract under which this fee schedule rate is established. Links the rate line to the governing contractual agreement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fee schedule rate record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: CMS Diagnosis Related Group code used for inpatient hospital reimbursement. When the payment methodology is DRG-based, this code identifies the patient classification group that determines the base payment rate.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fee schedule rate becomes effective and applicable for claims adjudication. Claims with service dates on or after this date and before the termination_date will be priced using this rate.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market area to which this rate applies. Rates may vary by state, CMS locality, metropolitan statistical area (MSA), or health plan-defined region. Expressed as a state code, CMS locality code, or internal region identifier.

attributes.name: global_surgery_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the global surgery period for surgical procedure codes. Defines the pre-operative and post-operative period during which related services are bundled into the surgical payment (0=endoscopic/minor, 10=minor, 90=major surgery).

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The Line of Business (LOB) to which this fee schedule rate applies. Rates are often differentiated by LOB as Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial plans have distinct reimbursement structures and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: mac_amount
attributes.description: The Maximum Allowable Cost (MAC) dollar amount set as the ceiling for reimbursement of a specific drug or service. When rate_derivation_method is MAC, this value represents the maximum the plan will pay regardless of billed charges.

attributes.name: max_units_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum number of units of this procedure code that will be reimbursed per day per member. Used to enforce utilization limits during claims adjudication and prevent overbilling.

attributes.name: max_units_per_year
attributes.description: Maximum number of units of this procedure code that will be reimbursed per benefit year per member. Enforces annual utilization limits during adjudication for services with frequency restrictions.

attributes.name: medicare_fee_schedule_pct
attributes.description: When rate_derivation_method is MEDICARE_PCT, this field stores the percentage of the applicable Medicare fee schedule rate used to derive the allowed amount. For example, 1.1500 represents 115% of Medicare. Used for rate benchmarking and contract analytics.

attributes.name: ncci_edit_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) Edit Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procedure code is subject to National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) bundling edits during claims adjudication. When true, the adjudication system will apply NCCI column 1/column 2 and mutually exclusive code edits.

tag_set.value: National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) Edit Indicator

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Identifies the provider network tier to which this rate applies. Rates differ by network participation level: IN_NETWORK (contracted), OUT_OF_NETWORK (non-contracted), or tiered preferred network levels (TIER_1, TIER_2, TIER_3, PREFERRED). Drives member cost-sharing calculations.

attributes.name: payment_methodology
attributes.description: The reimbursement methodology governing how the provider is paid for this service. FFS=Fee-for-Service (fixed allowed amount per procedure), CAPITATION=fixed PMPM regardless of utilization, BUNDLED=single payment for episode of care, DRG=Diagnosis Related Group inpatient payment, PER_DIEM=daily rate for facility stays, PERCENT_OF_BILLED=percentage of submitted charges, RBP=Reference Based Pricing, CASE_RATE=flat rate per case. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FFS|CAPITATION|BUNDLED|DRG|PER_DIEM|PERCENT_OF_BILLED|RBP|CASE_RATE — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
